observations: The page number «30» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L05 end chapter 36 (p. 29, JP2 0061): «Introi-|tus». L06-L07: the heading of chapter 37, in bold, centred, in two lines; in the left margin «C 90r, O 146r» beside the first and «N 56r» beside the second, the folio of N that the margin of p. 25 (JP2 0057) gives for the beginning of chapter 32 as well. L26 and L30: the vertical bars between «XXX22)» and «fuerit» and between «radiationum» and «differentia» mark the beginnings of fol. 56 verso of N and fol. 146 verso of O, which the notes in the left margin, «N 56v» and «O 146v», name; transcribed as margin notes.

L01-L05: the table of the houses is entered with any degree of the ascendant from Aries on, and gives the beginnings of the second to the sixth houses; the seventh corresponds to the first, the eighth to the second, and so on, so the other six are not given. Checked: the cusps of opposite houses are 180 degrees apart.

L06-L31: chapter 37, the rays of the planets, sextile («exagonalis»), quartile («tetragonalis») and trine («trigonalis»): the table is entered with the degree of the planet, or the next greater one, in the column of equal degrees; its six areas («areae») serve the ascendant in the fifth, tenth, fifteenth, twentieth, twenty-fifth and thirtieth degree of its sign; the value under the planet's sign is taken, the number of the ray written at the head of the page is added, and the sum, looked for in the same page, gives with the sign and the degrees at its head the place of the ray. For an ascendant between two of these degrees both columns are used and their difference is divided by five (continued on p. 31). Checked: the columns are five degrees of the ascendant apart, so that a fifth of the difference of two neighbouring columns is the change for one degree.

L21: a speck at mid-height before «offert»; L24: a speck above the comma after «excepto»; not transcribed. N03: the dash after «N.» stands 13 px from the point; the other dashes of the apparatus stand about 28 px from the word before them. N04 and N05: «XX.us», «XXV.us», «XXV.rio», the endings raised. N03 and N04: «Quomodo . . . inveniatur», «vel . . . quintus», three points; N08 «inter decimum . . . . XXX», four.
The colon and the semicolons of the text stand after the thin space of the edition (8-11 px measured).
